name: Agent-Context-Harness
summary: Per-turn router that sends each user message to the current task, an existing parallel worker, or a new parallel full-agent session, to keep context clean instead of compacting.

prior_art.verdict: Core idea shipped in Claude Code Projects. Open gaps: explicit inspectable router with confidence and eval set, session-thread-subagent tree view, nesting, vendor-neutral harness.

next_step: Phase 1: trial Claude Code Projects on a real repo and log routing decisions vs. intended (docs/development-plan.md).
